title: Fuel Cost Calculator
description: Estimate fuel needed and total cost for any trip from distance, fuel efficiency and current fuel price.
howto: Enter your trip distance, vehicle efficiency and fuel price.
Read the fuel needed, total trip cost and cost per mile/km instantly.

faqs.q: What is the difference between MPG and L/100km?
faqs.a: MPG (miles per gallon) rises with efficiency; L/100km falls with efficiency. Pick whichever your car's dashboard shows.

faqs.q: How do I convert my car's numbers?
faqs.a: L/100km = 235.214 ÷ MPG, and MPG = 235.214 ÷ L/100km. The tool handles each system separately.

faqs.q: Does this include tolls or wear and tear?
faqs.a: No, only fuel. Tolls, depreciation and maintenance are extra.
